run_quantization_oneshot: run post-training quantization on a transformer model using llmcompressor oneshot with a calibration dataset
create_quantization_recipe: create a quantization recipe targeting specific transformer layers like LlamaAttention with 8-bit float tensor strategy
preprocess_cal_dataset: preprocess and tokenize a HuggingFace dataset for model calibration with chat templates and truncation
test_quantized_model: test a quantized language model by generating text samples and verifying output quality
save_quantized_model: save a quantized transformer model and tokenizer to disk in compressed format
